name: Optimisarr Sidecar
description: Optimisarr Sidecar - remote encoding and verification worker that pairs with an Optimisarr server. Downloads job copies to its own /work scratch (no media-library mount needed) and advertises only encoders/decoders that pass real probes (CPU, Intel QSV/VA-API via /dev/dri; NVIDIA needs the host GPU runtime). DEV image tracks the gnolnos fork's dev branch. Pair once from the main server (Settings → Remote workers → Pair a sidecar); the dashboard listens on port 8788 and has no login, so keep it on a trusted network. Keep /config persistent (holds the private pairing credential - protect backups) and give /work at least twice the largest source size. Each worker needs its own config and scratch; do not scale replicas against the same volumes.

paths.name: Config directory
paths.description: Persistent private state: the pairing credential and transient health state. Keep it; protect backups.

paths.name: Work directory (scratch)
paths.description: Disposable job storage; needs at least twice the largest source free. Use a fast disk, or replace with a /work tmpfs for RAM scratch.

variables.name: Worker name
variables.description: How this worker appears on the main server.

variables.name: Concurrency
variables.description: Concurrent jobs (1-4). Budget CPU, GPU and scratch for every slot.

variables.name: Server URL
variables.description: Optional HTTP(S) address of the main Optimisarr server, reachable from inside this container (not localhost). Locks browser pairing to that server.

variables.name: Pairing code
variables.description: Optional one-time pairing code from the server's 'Pair a sidecar' (expires in 5 minutes); requires Server URL. Prefer pairing via the dashboard or a mounted secret.

variables.name: Encoder restriction
variables.description: Optional: restrict to one proven FFmpeg encoder name (e.g. hevc_qsv). Leave blank to advertise every encoder that passes its real probe.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the worker runs as after dropping privileges.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the worker runs as.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Permissions mask for files the worker creates.

devices.name: Intel/AMD GPU (/dev/dri)
devices.description: Optional. Map the render node for Intel QSV/VA-API or AMD VA-API hardware encoding (targets /dev/dri/renderD128). Remove if the host has no /dev/dri; only proved encoders are advertised.
